subject: Whether the fire-rated assembly listing shown in Project Specifications Division 00

messages.text: We need confirmation on whether the fire-rated assembly listing shown in Project Specifications Division 00 complies with the adopted code edition referenced in Section 03 30 00, though this may simply come down to what the design intended rather than a strict code reading. This is becoming a priority as the affected work proceeds. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. No schedule impact is expected. No hard deadline, just would like to keep this moving.
Confirmed compliant per Section 03 30 00; no code issue with the fire-rated assembly listing as detailed in Project Specifications Division 00. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum.
